paper.title_en: Test of T-invariance in double polarized scattering of protons and ligthest nuclei on deuterons
paper.abstract_en: The total cross section of the interaction of transversely polarized nucleuswith tensor-polarized deuteron constitues a null-test signal ofT-reversalinvariance violation under P-parity conservation.In our papers energy dependence of this signal was calculatedusing the spin-dependent Glauber theory for pd,$^{3}$He-d and dd double polarized scatteringat rather high energies.These results are briefly reviewed herewith the main focus on the pd scattering at $\sim $GeV energies.
